description: This file defines a custom matcher function 'toMatchAriaSnapshot' for use in testing, specifically for matching ARIA snapshots in Playwright tests. It includes logic for reading, comparing, and updating snapshot files, as well as utility functions for formatting snapshot strings.

methods.name: toMatchAriaSnapshot
methods.description: Asynchronous function that compares a locator's ARIA snapshot against a stored snapshot, with support for updating or generating new snapshots based on test configuration.

methods.name: unshift
methods.description: Utility function that removes common leading whitespace from each line in a snapshot string.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Utility function that indents each line of a snapshot string with a specified indentation.
